title: Adaptive thermodynamic, counterflow, and coherence atlas
question: Where are the narrowest constitutive and characteristic margins inside the declared discovery box when sampling is adaptively concentrated around convexity loss, poor eigenspace conditioning, and mode collisions?
prediction: All 832 boundary and adaptively selected states remain activated, causal, convex, and strongly hyperbolic in four directional orientations, while the adaptive search resolves finite positive convexity and distinct-mode margins.
falsifier: Any sampled state fails activation, causality, complete eigenspaces, scalar-constraint reduction, Legendre positivity, thermodynamic positivity, or the registered numerical tolerances.
controls: The exact 32 corners of the registered five-dimensional state box are always included.
The initial 32 cells cover the full box before priority refinement begins.
Cell priority is the maximum hazard from inverse convexity margin, eigenspace condition, and inverse distinct-mode gap.
Each selected five-dimensional cell is split in every coordinate, preventing one preferred coordinate from controlling refinement.
Every state is audited longitudinally, transversely, and in two oblique directions.
Repeated characteristic families are clustered before the nearest distinct-mode gap is measured.
seed_rationale: The adaptive priority rule, tie order, cells, corners, and directions are deterministic; no random sampling is used.
